items.summary: A high-latency System 2 planning routine for complex system design and research. By forcing structural abstraction, it deliberately shifts the model out of its local, high-probability semantic latent space—breaking conventional paradigm fixation. It spawns an isolated, blank-context sub-agent to engineer lateral cross-domain solutions, stress-tests the logic via in-domain patch loops, and synthesizes a metaphor-washed, highly optimized execution blueprint tailored for downstream worker agents.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of deep-planning-skill, enabling robust architecture and execution blueprints via lateral reasoning and metaphor-driven planning.

- Introduces a multi-phase deep planning protocol using a blank-context Domain Questioner to discover overlooked mechanisms.
- Provides strict guidance on when to use deep planning versus traditional tactical execution.
- Enforces strong context separation: the Domain Questioner must not see source-domain details.
- Supports both real and simulated subagent environments for context-isolated questioning.
- Outputs a self-contained, metaphor-free execution blueprint for complex, novel, or high-risk planning and design tasks.

latestVersion.changelog: v0.2.0: Add scripts/follow.py - tail -F equivalent for live log monitoring, log-aware. Streams new lines as they arrive with the same --pattern / --not-pattern / --level / --since filters as grep.py. Automatic log-rotation detection (inode change or file truncation triggers transparent reopen). --max-events N exits cleanly after N matched events (CI-friendly), --timeout SECONDS exits on inactivity, --json emits per-line JSON envelopes with extracted timestamp + level. Closes the only documented limitation from v0.1.x ('It does not tail/follow live log files').
